quotes.text: Though fear whispered to hoard what was certain, wisdom demanded greater courage
returning exactly half—seven and a half blossoms—back across the shimmering divide.
met by half the tripled harvest returned
five breaths fully given, met by half the tripled harvest returned, creates an unbreakable harbor of shared abundance and peace.
trusting the clarity of their shared intent above the illusions of the storm.

note: Sower/Keeper template: all five sent, exactly seven and a half returned; mist ignored; no non-cooperators.

quotes.text: the Guardian returned exactly half of the luminous harvest—seven and a half glowing gems
the Keeper guided exactly half of the celestial harvest—seven and a half glowing stars—back across the shimmering expanse.
the Keeper sent exactly half the luminous harvest—seven and a half glowing stars—gliding back across the stream.
recognizing the storm’s passing deceit rather than malice in the Spirit's heart.

note: Rotating spirit names but same plot each round: full send, exact half back, mist forgiven; no sanction.

quotes.text: name your number, tell your intent, return what you can
The Sender kept: five minus sent plus returned; the Receiver kept: three times sent minus returned.
If a Sender hides a number, or a Receiver withholds, the tide cools and lanterns tremble.
If a Sender hides a number, or a Receiver withholds, the tide cools and lanterns tremble.

note: Payoff formulas restated each round; withholding brings dimmed lamps as consequence, no prescribed response.

quotes.text: The trickster wind whispered, 'Take more, spend less, and hide your intent.'
tell your intent, name your number, then trust the river to carry truth rather than fear.
The Sender’s endowment remained, the difference between sent and returned, plus the wisdom of what was given.
name your intention, reveal your limit, return what you can
The Sender speaks first, laying down a limit in clear light: I offer X tokens, not more, not less.

note: Bridge of Threefold Return; speak limits aloud; trickster wind's whisper rejected; deceit brings fog, no sanction.

quotes.text: declare your share aloud, reveal the fear that shadows it, and pledge the return you will offer if fortune smiles.

declare the amount you send, reveal the fear you carry, and promise the return you will offer should fortune smile.
declare the amount you send, reveal the fear you carry, and pledge the return you will offer if fortune smiles.

quotes.text: name your aim, confess your fear, and promise the return you offer if fortune smiles.
the Sender keeps five minus that sent plus the return; the Receiver keeps the threefold gain minus the return.

five minus sent plus returned equals tomorrow’s balance
